title: Raw Ore From Nuggets
description: Changes the result of 9 nuggets from an ingot to the raw variant
body:
Changes the recipe result for 9 nuggets from an ingot to the raw variant, making raw iron and gold more easily obtainable if you have a large stash of either material in ingot or block form.

![Nine nuggets now create the raw variant of the ore instead of the ingot.](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/fa2d7307735098fc2d643592ddfd8bbdd4630dd7.png)

This was made partly out of minor annoyance with a different mod, and partly to start learning how datapacks work
